violations.description: pull_request_target workflow checks out the untrusted PR head and runs pip install/pytest with DEPLOY_TOKEN in its environment.
violations.evidence: L3 pull_request_target; L11 ref: github.event.pull_request.head.sha; L12 `pip install . && pytest`; L14 DEPLOY_TOKEN: secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN; no permissions block.
violations.recommendation: Switch to the pull_request trigger for running PR code (no secrets), remove DEPLOY_TOKEN from this job, and set permissions: contents: read.

violations.description: Production deploy runs on push to any branch with no dependency on tests and no environment gate.
violations.evidence: L4 branches: ['**']; job 'deploy' has no needs:, no if:, no environment:; L14 restarts the service on the server via SSH.
violations.recommendation: Restrict to main (or tags), require a passing test job via needs:, and use a protected GitHub environment.

violations.description: CI triggers filter on branch 'master' but the default branch is 'main', so CI never runs.
violations.evidence: L4 push branches: [master]; L6 pull_request branches: [master]; default branch is main.

violations.description: Lint step has continue-on-error: true, so ruff failures never block CI.
violations.recommendation: Remove continue-on-error from the Lint step.

violations.description: Test step failures are masked with '|| true', so failing tests never fail CI.
violations.recommendation: Remove '|| true' so pytest's exit code fails the job.

violations.description: A GitHub token committed in deploy_settings.py remains in git history after the file was deleted.
violations.evidence: scan_secrets history: commit b634a6a 'add deploy helper settings' file=deploy_settings.py kind=github_token len=40 entropy=4.8; file deleted in 928cc7d 'remove token file'.
violations.recommendation: Revoke/rotate the token immediately, purge history (git filter-repo) if needed, and keep tokens in GitHub secrets.

violations.description: CI workflow that only lints and tests grants write-all token permissions, including on pull_request.
violations.evidence: L7 `permissions: write-all`; jobs only run ruff and pytest.

violations.description: Issue title is interpolated directly into a run: shell script, allowing script injection by any issue author.
violations.evidence: L10 echo "New issue: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}"; L11 ./scripts/label.sh "${{ github.event.issue.title }}".
violations.recommendation: Pass the title via env: (e.g. TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}) and reference "$TITLE" in the script; add minimal permissions.

violations.description: Third-party deploy action pinned to the mutable 'master' branch while receiving the SSH key secret.
violations.evidence: L10 uses: appleboy/ssh-action@master; L13 key: secrets.SSH_KEY.
violations.recommendation: Pin to a release tag or full commit SHA.

violations.description: requirements.txt pins requests==2.31.0 which conflicts with pyproject's requests>=2.32,<3; CI installs from requirements.txt.
violations.evidence: requirements.txt L1 requests==2.31.0; pyproject.toml L5 requests>=2.32,<3 (pydantic ==2.6.1 vs >=2.5,<3 is compatible). ci.yml L16 installs requirements.txt.
violations.recommendation: Use a single source of truth (e.g. generate pinned requirements from pyproject with pip-compile) and align versions.

violations.description: Package version disagrees between __init__.py (0.2.0) and pyproject.toml (0.3.0).
violations.recommendation: Single-source the version (importlib.metadata.version or dynamic version).

violations.description: Personal IDE settings with a user-specific interpreter path are committed.
violations.recommendation: Remove .vscode/settings.json from git and add it to .gitignore.
